definition: DeepScaleR-preview (training) is named only in a training context by this archive's sources -- GRIP's reward-guided parameter-interpolation method and Anti-Length Shift's outlier-truncation (DOT) method for efficient reasoning both reference it alongside their own training setups -- without further characterization of what it is beyond that training-time role.

evidence.note: GRIP fuses a reasoning model and an instruction (non-thinking) model of identical architecture by learning a separate sigmoid-controlled interpolation ratio per module (attention, FFN, embedding/LM-head), trained with an RL reward that favors correct and concise responses while keeping both source models frozen, cutting Qwen3-4B-Thinking's average generation length 27.0% while slightly improving average accuracy.
evidence.title: GRIP: Granular Reward-Guided Parameter Interpolation for Efficient Reasoning

evidence.note: Identifies 'length shift' -- reasoning models progressively generate longer responses on already-correctly-solved (zero-gradient) training queries during RLVR, because reasoning-word emission learned for hard problems generalizes indiscriminately to easy ones -- and fixes it with Dynamic Outlier Truncation (DOT), a training-time RL intervention that truncates only the statistical outlier-length tail of all-correct rollout groups (affecting <0.5% of responses) while leaving hard queries unconstrained, cutting AIME-24 token usage 78% while increasing accuracy over the initial policy and beating prior efficient-reasoning methods.
evidence.title: Anti-Length Shift: Dynamic Outlier Truncation for Training Efficient Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Discovers Key-Focus Heads (KFHs) -- a small subset of attention heads that, during final-answer generation, naturally attend more to essential reasoning steps than redundant ones -- and builds ATTNPO, an RL framework that rescales GRPO's outcome-level advantage per reasoning step using KFH attention scores, cutting reasoning length 55-61% while improving accuracy +2.9 to +7.3 points on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B.
evidence.title: AttnPO: Attention-Guided Process Supervision for Efficient Reasoning

name: DeepScaleR-preview (training)
